children: Winchester Bancorp, Inc. reported net income of $4.4M for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, up from a loss of $0.9M a year earlier, driven by higher net interest income and margin expansion on revenue of $26.3M.
Revenue was $26.3M for the year ended June 30, 2026, compared with $19.3M in 2025; YoY change 36.1%.
Net income was $4.4M for the year ended June 30, 2026, compared with $(0.9)M in 2025; YoY change +$5.3M.
Diluted EPS was $0.49 for the year ended June 30, 2026, compared with $(0.10) in 2025.
Revenue growth and profitability: Improved to $4.4M net income in FY2026 from a prior-year loss, driven by higher net interest income and margin expansion.
Loan and channel expansion: Loans grew approximately 15.9%, led by 1-4 family, multi-family and construction lending; expansion of broker channels increased residential originations.
Deposit mix shift: Significant increase in money market accounts (up 116%), attributable in part to a new municipal deposit channel.

Operational investments: The bank increased staffing in commercial lending and accounting, implemented a new bonus plan, and completed major software rollouts including cash management, ACL, and commercial credit systems.
Asset-liability and liquidity management: Active ALCO oversight with strategies to manage interest-rate risk, maintain liquidity and diversify the loan mix for stability.
